D"],"published-print":{"date-parts":[[2007,12]]},"abstract":"<jats:p>\n                    Atomic Clock Ensemble in Space (ACES) is a mission in fundamental physics that will operate a new generation of atomic clocks in the microgravity environment of the International Space Station. Fractional frequency stability and accuracy of a few parts in 10\n                    <jats:sup>16<\/jats:sup>\n                    will be achieved. The on-board time base, distributed on the Earth via a microwave link, will be used to perform space-to-ground as well as ground-to-ground comparisons of atomic frequency standards. Based on these comparisons, ACES will perform fundamental physics tests (Einstein's theories of special and general relativity, the search for drift of fundamental constants, the Standard Model extension and tests of string theories) and develop applications in time and frequency metrology, time scales, geodesy, global positioning and navigation. After an overview of the mission concept and its scientific objectives, the present status of ACES instruments and subsystems will be discussed.\n                  <\/jats:p>","DOI":"10.1142\/s0218271807011681","type":"journal-article","created":{"date-parts":[[2008,2,22]],"date-time":"2008-02-22T05:57:59Z","timestamp":1203659879000},"page":"2511-2523","source":"Crossref","is-referenced-by-count":25,"title":["ATOMIC CLOCK ENSEMBLE IN SPACE: AN UPDATE"],"prefix":"10.1142","volume":"16","author":[{"given":"C.","family":"SALOMON","sequence":"first","affiliation":[{"name":"Laboratoire Kastler Brossel, ENS, 24, rue Lhomond, 75005 Paris, France"}],"role":[{"vocabulary":"crossref","role":"author"}]},{"given":"L.","family":"CACCIAPUOTI","sequence":"additional","affiliation":[{"name":"European Space Agency, Research and Scientific Support Department, ESTEC, Keplerlaan 1\u2013PO Box 299, 2200 AG Noordwijk ZH, The Netherlands"}],"role":[{"vocabulary":"crossref","role":"author"}]},{"given":"N.","family":"DIMARCQ","sequence":"additional","affiliation":[{"name":"SYRTE-CNRS UMR8630, Observatoire de Paris, 61, avenue de l'Observatoire 75014 Paris, France"}],"role":[{"vocabulary":"crossref","role":"author"}]}],"member":"219","published-online":{"date-parts":[[2012,1,25]]},"reference":[{"key":"rf1","first-page":"1313","author":"Salomon C.","journal-title":"C.
